claims: NYSE identity/tradability is validated; Q2 certification/runway claims trace to issuer/SEC-furnished evidence, with independent current reporting corroborating the autonomy milestone and market re-rating.

Joby has final-stage certification progress, five aircraft flying, twelve in production, Toyota manufacturing support and $2.3B Q2 liquidity, but certification, scaled unit economics and burn remain unresolved.

thesisQuality.basis: Certification progress and flight/manufacturing evidence validate capability, but commercial product-market economics remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: $2.3B liquidity supports execution but material cash use and pre-scale economics remain pressure points.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Recent market re-rating reflects high uncertainty; without proven commercial economics valuation remains demanding relative to evidence.

catalystScore.basis: Final FAA certification stage, conforming aircraft and autonomy milestones create identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Execution milestones and Toyota partnership support operator credibility, while capital intensity limits stronger judgment.

alignment2036.basis: Electric/autonomous aviation can address mobility, logistics, emergency and defense needs across multiple future scenarios.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Passenger eVTOL plus autonomous logistics/dual-use applications reuse aviation/autonomy capabilities.

bottleneckControl.basis: Certification/manufacturing integration creates barriers, but infrastructure and regulatory dependencies remain external.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Dual-use autonomy adds optionality, but the core thesis still depends materially on certification and commercialization.

substitutionResilience.basis: Integrated aircraft/autonomy offers differentiation but helicopters, ground transport and rival eVTOLs remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Toyota manufacturing support improves execution capacity, but scaled aerospace supply resilience is not yet demonstrated.

pricingPower.basis: No scaled commercial passenger economics or durable price realization is yet demonstrated.

riskEvidence.basis: Certification, manufacturing scale, cash burn, infrastructure and utilization/unit economics remain major risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Primary evidence is fresh and specific, but the most important commercial economics remain prospective.

scoreRecord.thesis: Joby has credible certification/manufacturing progress and autonomy optionality, but durable value depends on converting technical milestones into certified, scaled, economically viable service.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Certification or commercialization delays can consume liquidity before unit economics are proven.
